previous_statement: Historical-to-modern compatibility obligation: every compact modern C^1 manifold M is a manifold of class one in the Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead sense and admits an atlas A all of whose coordinate systems are allowable in that sense.
new_statement: Scope audit: the allowed inputs do not establish the historical-to-modern compatibility assertion that every compact modern C^1 manifold is a Cairns/Veblen-Whitehead class-one manifold admitting an allowable atlas; that assertion therefore remains an unproved obligation.
